real_use_case: Validate the structural envelope of a single-sample VCF before downstream processing.
upstream_status: GA4GH HTS VCF 4.5 canonical specification; checked 2026-09-22.
license: Independent project implementation; no third-party implementation or fixture bytes copied.
supported_profile: VCF 4.5 text, UTF-8, exactly one sample, uncompressed bytes.
resource_budget: Single pass over input with bounded parser state; no network or subprocess.
known_issues: No reference concordance, normalization, interpretation, full structured meta-information grammar validation, BGZF, BCF, gVCF, or structural-variant semantic validation.
security: Pure bytes parser with no filesystem, network, or subprocess access.
disable_path: Not wired to any default execution pipeline.
